subject: Request: post-pilot promotional allowance and invoice offset guidance
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot top-up / credit memo — BlueHill (post-bill)

Irene — quick one from Sales. BlueHill finished their 6-week pilot last week and asked us to apply a promotional credit for overage tolerance and provide the accounting treatment so they can close their procurement request.

Summary:
- Customer: BlueHill AI (PO on file)
- Original invoice: INV-6241 issued 2027-10-28 for $18,250 (pilot consumption)
- Promo ask: $4,000 promotional allowance (applied as credit memo, post-bill) + 2-week trial extension offered earlier

They want the credit applied as an invoice offset if possible, instead of issuing a standalone refund. Attached is the customer confirmation and the pilot usage CSV.

Can we get guidance on:
1) GL mapping for the credit memo (contra revenue vs. promotional allowance G/L)
2) Whether we should net the credit against INV-6241 or issue a credit memo and leave the invoice posted (customer prefers netting)
3) If any accrual reversal or deferred revenue impact to flag to RevRec team

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is blocking their PO close.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bluehill_pilot_usage_nov_report.csv (CSV)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up / credit memo — BlueHill (post-bill)

Thanks Ben — looping in Accounting (Marcus) and Billing (Marissa) for treatment. Quick notes from my side:

- We generally prefer netting the credit against the invoice when the customer explicitly requests it and it's just a promotional allowance tied to the billed period. That keeps AR tidy for procurement.
- For bookkeeping: post a credit memo referencing INV-6241 and apply it as an invoice offset (do not issue a cash refund).
- GL recommendation: post to G/L 6740 "Promotional Allowances" (contra revenue). Do NOT post to Sales Discounts (G/L 4002) unless Finance requests otherwise.

Marcus / Marissa — please confirm the journal entry specifics (debit/credit lines, reversal/accrual notes) and whether this requires an adjusting accrual or affects deferred revenue. Also confirm if we should attach the customer confirmation and copy the HubSpot deal.

Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the context and the signed confirmation. Accounting guidance below (ready for Billing to action):

1) Mechanic: Create Credit Memo CM-2027-1103 linked to INV-6241 for $4,000 and apply as an invoice offset (net the AR). Do not issue cash refund.

2) Journal entries:
- Debit G/L 3100 Accounts Receivable $4,000 (apply credit memo)
- Credit G/L 6740 Promotional Allowances $4,000 (contra revenue account)

3) Accrual / RevRec impact: No change to deferred revenue required — this is a post-bill promotional allowance for already-delivered pilot consumption. However, if RevRec had previously recognized revenue tied to an accrual specifically for promotional offers, we'll mark this as an adjustment in ACCT-2438 and notify RevRec. For the normal case, no reversal.

4) Tax/FX: Customer is US-based, no VAT — no tax journal aside from normal AR postings. Currency is USD.

5) Attachments & audit trail: Billing should upload BH_creditmemo_0423.pdf and the signed confirmation to the accounting ticket (ACCT-2438) and link the HubSpot deal DL-2027-0118-BH. Include a note that the credit memo was customer-requested and applied as offset.

Marissa — please create CM-2027-1103 tomorrow morning, apply it to INV-6241, post the two-line journal, and add the attachments. Ben — confirm extension dates with Ayla and add to the HubSpot timeline.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Accounting — Revenue
Redwood Inference
